authority: Konami official Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Card Database
purpose: Factual source review and 2v2 implementation triage for the first ten cards in the current milestone worklist. This file is not a runtime implementation, behavior test, or certification.

sourcePolicy.cardText: Effect descriptions below are concise paraphrases of the official card text, not verbatim reproductions.
sourcePolicy.historicalCutoff: Historical eligibility is intentionally unconfirmed. TCG first-release dates alone must not be used to infer OCG eligibility at the 2004-09-30 cutoff.
sourcePolicy.certification: No card is certified by this review or by importing this file.

cards.name: 3-Hump Lacooda
cards.effectSummary: If three copies are face-up on the controller's field, Tribute exactly two of those copies to draw three cards.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: Count all three copies on the team's shared Monster Zones, regardless of physical owner.
The cost is exactly two copies; the third copy must remain on the field.
Resolve the draw to the physical deck/hand selected by the active effect controller without changing card ownership.
Preserve the UIDs and physical owners of both Tributed copies in the shared Graveyard.

cards.name: 8-Claws Scorpion
cards.effectSummary: Once per turn it may turn itself face-down in Defense Position; when it attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, its ATK becomes 2400 for Damage Calculation only.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The once-per-turn position change must use the normal legal position-change window.
The 2400 ATK value applies only during Damage Calculation and must not persist in public stats or later attacks.
The condition requires a face-down Defense Position target, not a face-up Defense monster.

cards.name: A Cat of Ill Omen
cards.effectSummary: On Flip, choose a Trap from the controller's Deck and place it on top; if Necrovalley is on the field, the Trap may be added to the hand instead.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The trigger is a Flip effect and must not resolve merely because the card is revealed.
Search the correct physical Deck and preserve the selected card UID.
Necrovalley must be checked on the shared field at resolution; only then is adding to hand available.
Without Necrovalley, the selected Trap goes to the top of the physical Deck, not the hand.

cards.name: A Man with Wdjat
cards.effectSummary: When Normal Summoned and during each of its controller's Standby Phases, select one Set card on the opponent's field, privately inspect it, then restore it to its original position.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The trigger occurs on Normal Summon and on each applicable Standby Phase.
The selected card may be in either opposing physical seat's shared backrow.
The card identity is private information for the resolving player; do not leak it in the public Discord payload or the partner's private hand panel.
Restore the card to the same zone and face-down state after inspection.

cards.name: A-Team: Trap Disposal Unit
cards.effectSummary: During either player's turn, when the opponent activates a Trap, Tribute this face-up monster to negate that Trap's activation and destroy it.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: This is a quick response to an opponent's Trap activation, not a continuous Trap lock.
The source must be face-up and physically available on the shared field when the response is offered.
Pay the Tribute once, preserve its physical UID in the correct Graveyard, and negate/destroy only the activating Trap.
In 2v2, authorization belongs to the active representative of the responding team.

cards.name: Absorbing Kid from the Sky
cards.effectSummary: When it destroys a monster by battle and that monster is sent to the Graveyard, its controller gains LP equal to the destroyed monster's Level multiplied by 300.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The trigger requires battle destruction and a Graveyard destination; banishment or other removal must not trigger it.
Use the destroyed monster's original Level, not the source monster's Level.
Apply the gain to the shared LP of the source's team exactly once.
Preserve the physical owner of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

cards.name: Abyss Soldier
cards.effectSummary: Once per turn, discard a WATER monster to the Graveyard to target one card on the field and return it to the hand.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The cost must be a WATER monster from the activating physical player's hand, not the partner's private hand.
The target may be any card on the field, not only a monster.
Return the target to its physical owner's hand and preserve its UID.
Reject illegal targets and unavailable discard costs before acknowledgement.

cards.name: Agido
cards.effectSummary: If destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, roll a six-sided die; the controller may Special Summon a Fairy from the Graveyard whose Level equals the result, or a Level 6-or-higher Fairy on a result of six.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The trigger requires battle destruction and a Graveyard destination.
Use a six-sided result from 1 to 6 and make the Special Summon optional.
On six, allow Level 6 or higher; on one through five, require an exact Level match.
Search the team's shared Graveyard while preserving the summoned card's physical owner and checking the shared three-zone capacity.

cards.name: Airknight Parshath
cards.effectSummary: It inflicts piercing battle damage when attacking a Defense Position monster; if it inflicts battle damage, its controller draws one card.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: Calculate piercing damage from ATK minus DEF and apply it to the opposing team's shared LP.
Draw only when battle damage was actually inflicted; zero damage must not trigger the draw.
Draw one card for the physical controller's own Deck, not the inactive partner's private Deck.
Keep piercing and draw as distinct parts of the same battle resolution.

cards.name: Amazoness Blowpiper
cards.effectSummary: During each of its controller's Standby Phases, select one face-up opponent monster; that monster loses 500 ATK until the end of the turn.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: Offer the trigger in each applicable Standby Phase and select one face-up monster from either opposing seat.
The -500 ATK modifier lasts only until the end of that turn and must not alter printed ATK.
A face-down target is not legal.
Preserve target identity and clear the temporary modifier at the correct turn boundary.
